description.uz: 1klinik — klinikalarni boshqarish tizimi; Surxondaryo viloyatida faoliyat yuritadi.
description.en: 1klinik is a clinic management system operating in the Surkhandarya region.

tagline.uz: Biznes va savdo nuqtalarini oson avtomatlashtirish
tagline.en: Easy automation for businesses and points of sale

description.uz: 1POS biznes va savdo nuqtalarini oson avtomatlashtirishga mo‘ljallangan ERP tizimi.
description.en: 1POS is an ERP system designed to make automating businesses and points of sale easy.

tagline.uz: Shahar ichida haydovchi va yo‘lovchini birlashtiradi
tagline.en: Connects drivers and passengers within the city

description.uz: 1Way shahar ichida bir manzil tomon ketayotgan haydovchi va yo‘lovchini birlashtiradi.
description.en: 1Way connects drivers and passengers who are heading to the same destination within the city.

tagline.en: Teaches programming and prepares for jobs

description.uz: 27 Code — dasturlashga o‘rgatadigan va o‘quvchilarni ishga tayyorlaydigan ta’lim startapi.
description.en: 27 Code is an education startup that teaches programming and prepares students for employment.

tagline.uz: Kameralar orqali xodimlar ish vaqti hisobi

description.uz: AbsVision — kameralar orqali xodimlarni aniqlab, kelish-ketish va ish vaqtini avtomatik qayd etuvchi tizim. Zonalar bo‘yicha kuzatuv, real vaqtdagi ogohlantirishlar, hisobotlar va HR hamda payroll tizimlariga integratsiyani taklif qiladi.
description.en: AbsVision is a system that identifies employees via cameras and automatically records arrival, departure and working time. It offers zone-based monitoring, real-time alerts, reports and integration with HR and payroll systems.

tagline.uz: Bilimni bosqichma-bosqich o‘rgatuvchi AI ta’lim platformasi
tagline.en: AI learning platform that teaches step by step

description.uz: ACED — sun’iy intellekt asosidagi ta’lim platformasi. Har bir mavzu bosqichlarga bo‘lingan: tushuntirish, misollar, mashq, amaliy topshiriqlar va test; foydalanuvchi bosqichni bajarmay keyingisiga o‘ta olmaydi.
description.en: ACED is an AI-based learning platform. Each topic is split into stages: explanation, examples, practice, hands-on tasks and a test; users cannot move on without completing each stage.

tagline.en: Moving brand advertising across the city

description.uz: AdRide — xususiy va davlat korxonalari uchun targeting yechimi. Brendingiz bir oy davomida shahar bo‘ylab harakatlanib, keng auditoriya e’tiboriga tushadi.
description.en: AdRide is a targeting solution for private and public companies. Your brand travels around the city for a month and reaches a wide audience.

tagline.uz: Biznesni UGC kreatorlar bilan bog‘lovchi platforma
tagline.en: Platform connecting businesses with UGC creators

description.uz: Adscape — bizneslarni UGC (foydalanuvchilar yaratgan kontent) kreatorlari va blogerlar bilan bog‘lovchi innovatsion marketing platformasi.
description.en: Adscape is an innovative marketing platform that connects businesses with UGC (user-generated content) creators and bloggers.

tagline.uz: Sun’iy intellektni hamma uchun qulay qilamiz

description.uz: Aether — sun’iy intellektni oddiy foydalanuvchilar uchun qulay va tushunarli qiluvchi startap. Uchta mahsuloti bor: Aether UI (vizual veb-sayt quruvchi), Aether Logic (AI workflow yaratuvchisi) va Aether Voxel (matndan 3D model generatori).
description.en: Aether is a startup making AI easy and understandable for everyday users. Its three products are Aether UI (visual website builder), Aether Logic (AI workflow builder) and Aether Voxel (text-to-3D model generator).

description.uz: Agent father — Toshkent shahrida faoliyat yuritadigan startap.
description.en: Agent father is a startup based in Tashkent.

tagline.uz: Kod yozmasdan shaxsiy AI agent yaratish platformasi
tagline.en: Platform for building personal AI agents without code

description.uz: Agentus kod bilmaydigan odamlarga ham o‘z shaxsiy 24/7 ishlaydigan AI agentlarini yaratish imkonini beradi. Agentlarni marketplace’da sotish mumkin; platforma mahalliy til va Markaziy Osiyo bozoriga moslashtirilgan.
description.en: Agentus lets even people who cannot code create their own AI agents that work 24/7. Agents can be sold on a marketplace, and the platform is adapted to the local language and the Central Asian market.

description.uz: Agro Care — qishloq xo‘jaligi uchun mo‘ljallangan AgriTech va marketpleys sohasidagi startap; sun’iy intellektdan foydalanadi va Qashqadaryo viloyatida faoliyat yuritadi.
description.en: Agro Care is an AgriTech and marketplace startup for agriculture that uses artificial intelligence; it operates in Kashkadarya region.

tagline.en: A startup based in the Jizzakh region

description.uz: Agrochayn — Jizzax viloyatida faoliyat yuritadigan startap.
description.en: Agrochayn is a startup based in the Jizzakh region.

tagline.uz: SI yordamida o‘simlik kasalliklarini aniqlash ilovasi
tagline.en: AI app for diagnosing plant diseases

description.uz: AgroDoctor — dehqon, bog‘bon va o‘simliksevarlar uchun ilova. Sun’iy intellekt yordamida o‘simlik kasalligini aniqlaydi, foydalanuvchi ilovada o‘z bog‘ini yaratishi mumkin.
description.en: AgroDoctor is an app for farmers, gardeners and plant lovers. It uses AI to diagnose plant diseases, and users can create their own garden in the app.

description.uz: AgroM — Startup Garage rezidenti bo‘lgan startap; Toshkent shahrida faoliyat yuritadi.
description.en: AgroM is a startup resident of Startup Garage, based in Tashkent City.

description.uz: Agronazorat — qishloq xo‘jaligi (AgriTech) sohasidagi startap; Toshkent shahrida faoliyat yuritadi.
description.en: Agronazorat is a startup in the AgriTech sector, operating in Tashkent City.

description.uz: AgroZone — AgriTech sohasidagi startap; Toshkent shahrida faoliyat yuritadi.
description.en: AgroZone is a startup in the AgriTech sector, based in Tashkent City.

tagline.en: A startup based in the Bukhara region

description.uz: AI Mahalla — Buxoro viloyatida faoliyat yuritadigan startap.
description.en: AI Mahalla is a startup based in the Bukhara region.

description.uz: ALBUS — Toshkent shahrida faoliyat yuritayotgan startap.
description.en: ALBUS is a startup operating in Tashkent City.

tagline.uz: Restoranlar va kafelar uchun aqlli ERP va POS tizimi
tagline.en: Smart ERP and POS system for restaurants and cafes

description.uz: AliPos — restoranlar, kafelar va tarmoqlar uchun aqlli ERP va POS tizimi.
description.en: AliPos is a smart ERP and POS system for restaurants, cafes and chains.

tagline.uz: Kredit, bo‘lib to‘lash va P2P qarz ma’lumotlari yagona tizimda
tagline.en: Credit, installment and P2P debt data in one system

description.uz: AMANAT — kredit, bo‘lib to‘lash va P2P qarz ma’lumotlarini yagona tizimda birlashtiruvchi moliyaviy ishonchlilik platformasi. Bizneslarga mijozning umumiy qarzdorligi va risk darajasini ko‘rib, tezroq va ishonchli qaror qabul qilishga yordam beradi.
description.en: AMANAT is a financial reliability platform that brings credit, installment and P2P debt data into one system. It helps businesses see a customer's overall debt and risk level and make faster, more reliable decisions.

tagline.uz: Ko‘zi ojizlar uchun sun'iy intellektli ko‘zoynak
tagline.en: AI-powered glasses for the visually impaired

description.uz: Aqlli ko‘zoynak sun'iy intellekt yordamida atrofdagi obyektlarni taniydi va ular haqida quloqchin orqali ovozli ma‘lumot beradi. U ko‘zi ojizlar uchun mo‘ljallangan.
description.en: Aqlli ko‘zoynak uses artificial intelligence to recognize surrounding objects and describes them by voice through earphones. It is designed for visually impaired people.

description.uz: Aqlligim — Buxoro viloyatida faoliyat yuritadigan startap.
description.en: Aqlligim is a startup based in Bukhara region.

tagline.uz: Sun’iy intellekt asosidagi moslashuvchan o‘quv kurslari

description.uz: Aqlum — O‘zbekistondagi EdTech startapi bo‘lib, markazlashgan platforma va sun’iy intellekt yordamida moslashuvchan o‘quv kurslarini taqdim etishga qaratilgan.
description.en: Aqlum is an EdTech startup in Uzbekistan focused on offering flexible learning courses through a centralized platform and artificial intelligence.

description.uz: Archmodel — Toshkent shahrida faoliyat yuritayotgan startap.
description.en: Archmodel is a startup based in Tashkent City.

tagline.uz: Dizayn va poligrafiya xizmatlari uchun startap
tagline.en: Startup for design and print services

description.uz: asox market — O‘zbekistonda shaxsiy dizayn va poligrafiya xizmatlarini qulayroq va shaffofroq qilishga qaratilgan startap. U an’anaviy jarayondagi uzoq kutish, noaniq narx va kichik buyurtmalar muammolarini hal etishni maqsad qiladi.
description.en: asox market is a startup aiming to make personal design and printing services in Uzbekistan more convenient and transparent. It seeks to address the long waits, unclear prices and lack of support for small orders in the traditional process.

description.uz: Astervis — Startup Garage rezidenti bo‘lgan startap; Toshkent shahrida faoliyat yuritadi.
description.en: Astervis is a startup resident of Startup Garage, based in Tashkent City.

description.uz: Audit Ai — audit o‘tkazishga yordam beradigan loyiha; Toshkent shahrida faoliyat yuritadi.
description.en: Audit Ai is a project that helps with conducting audits, operating in Tashkent City.

tagline.uz: Radiologlar uchun yangi avlod AI platformasi

description.uz: AviRadiology — O‘zbekistonda ishlab chiqilgan, radiolog shifokorlar uchun mo‘ljallangan sun’iy intellekt platformasi. Tizim rentgen yoki KT kabi tibbiy tasvirlarni tahlil qilib, ish unumdorligini oshirishga qaratilgan.
description.en: AviRadiology is an AI platform developed in Uzbekistan for radiologists. It analyzes medical images such as X-rays or CT scans, aiming to boost productivity.

tagline.uz: Shifokorlar va bemorlarni birlashtiruvchi AI sog‘liqni saqlash ekotizimi
tagline.en: AI healthcare ecosystem connecting doctors and patients

description.uz: AviShifo — sun’iy intellekt yordamida shifokorlar va bemorlarni birlashtirgan raqamli ekotizim. Platforma intellektual diagnostika, raqamli kasallik tarixi, onlayn qabul, simptomlarni yig‘ish va qabul sifatini baholash modullarini taqdim etadi; yechim mahalliy tibbiy protokollarni hisobga olgan holda ishlab chiqilgan.
description.en: AviShifo is a digital ecosystem that connects doctors and patients using artificial intelligence. The platform offers intelligent diagnostics, digital medical records, online appointments, symptom collection and a visit-quality assessment module, built around local medical protocols.

tagline.uz: Yo‘lda qolgan haydovchilar uchun tezkor yordam
tagline.en: Fast help for drivers stranded on the road

description.uz: Avten — yo‘lda qolgan haydovchilar uchun tezkor yordam xizmati. Bir tugma bilan yordam chaqirish mumkin.
description.en: Avten is a rapid assistance service for drivers stranded on the road. Help can be called with a single button.

tagline.uz: Yoqilg‘i va EV quvvatlash shoxobchalari haqida mobil ilova
tagline.en: Mobile app for fuel and EV charging stations

description.uz: Avto24 — O‘zbekistondagi yoqilg‘i quyish, gaz to‘ldirish va elektromobillarni quvvatlash shoxobchalari haqida batafsil ma’lumot beruvchi interaktiv mobil ilova. U foydalanuvchilarga eng yaqin va qulay shoxobchani topishga yordam beradi.
description.en: Avto24 is an interactive mobile app with details on fuel, gas and electric vehicle charging stations in Uzbekistan. It helps users find the nearest and most convenient station.

description.uz: AvtoInfo — Startup Garage dasturida ishtirok etayotgan startap.
description.en: AvtoInfo is a startup participating in the Startup Garage program.

tagline.en: AI recruiter that automates HR processes

description.uz: Aziza — sun'iy intellektga asoslangan AI rekruter agenti. U nomzodlar ma‘lumotlarini yig‘adi, rezyumelarni tahlil qiladi, ovozli suhbat o‘tkazadi va mos nomzodlar bilan uchrashuv belgilaydi.
description.en: Aziza is an AI recruiter agent that automates HR processes. It collects candidate data, analyzes resumes, conducts voice interviews and schedules meetings with suitable candidates.

description.uz: Azmuglobal — Startup Garage dasturi rezidenti bo‘lgan startap.
description.en: Azmuglobal is a startup in the Startup Garage program.

description.uz: Babai — biznes jarayonlarini sun’iy intellekt yordamida avtomatlashtirishga qaratilgan startap; Samarqand viloyatida faoliyat yuritadi.
description.en: Babai is a startup focused on automating business processes with AI; it operates in Samarkand region.

tagline.uz: Loyihalar va AI yechimlarini tahlil qilish va baholash tizimi
tagline.en: System for analyzing and evaluating projects and AI solutions

description.uz: Baholab AI loyihalar, biznes jarayonlari yoki sun’iy intellekt yechimlarini tahlil qilish, ularning samaradorligini o‘lchash va muayyan mezonlar asosida baholashga xizmat qiluvchi tizim.
description.en: Baholab AI is a system for analyzing projects, business processes or AI solutions, measuring their effectiveness and evaluating them against defined criteria.

description.uz: BaiSoft — Toshkent shahrida faoliyat yuritadigan startap.
description.en: BaiSoft is a startup based in Tashkent City.

tagline.uz: Chorvachilik va qishloq xo‘jaligi uchun agro-ekotizim

description.uz: Barakami — chorvachilik va qishloq xo‘jaligini raqamlashtirishga qaratilgan agro-ekotizim platformasi. U chorvadorlar, veterinarlar, agronomlar va agromahsulot sotuvchilarni bitta tizimda birlashtiradi.
description.en: Barakami is an agro-ecosystem platform aimed at digitizing livestock and agriculture. It unites livestock farmers, veterinarians, agronomists and agro-product sellers in one system.

description.uz: BBOX — MVP bosqichidagi startap; Toshkent shahrida faoliyat yuritadi.
description.en: BBOX is an MVP-stage startup based in Tashkent City.

description.uz: BeautiX — kosmetika mahsulotlari uchun onlayn marketpleys.
description.en: BeautiX is an online marketplace for cosmetic products.

description.uz: Beautly — go‘zallik xizmatlari uchun marketplace: mijoz bitta ilovada shahar bo‘ylab salonlar, ustalar, narxlar va bo‘sh soatlarni ko‘rib, bir necha bosishda yoziladi. Salonlar uchun bronlar, ustalar jadvali va mijozlar bazasini boshqarish kabineti mavjud.
description.en: Beautly is a marketplace for beauty services: in one app, customers see salons, specialists, prices and available time slots across the city and book in a few taps. Salons get a cabinet to manage bookings, specialist schedules and their client base.

description.uz: Bigmart — O‘zbekistondagi biznes uchun ofis, ombor va maishiy tovarlarni bir joyda birlashtirgan B2B marketpleys. Kompaniyalar, ofislar va omborlar yagona shaxsiy kabinet orqali tez va qulay xarid qiladi.
description.en: Bigmart is a B2B marketplace for businesses in Uzbekistan that brings office, warehouse and household goods together in one place. Companies, offices and warehouses purchase quickly through a single personal account.

tagline.uz: Sayohatni eng arzon narxda tashkil qilish
tagline.en: Plan your trip at the lowest price

description.uz: Biletchi — sayohatni eng arzon narxda tashkil qilishga yordam beradigan TravelTech startapi.
description.en: Biletchi is a TravelTech startup that helps organize trips at the lowest price.

description.uz: BiliMind — imtihonga tayyorgarlik uchun sun’iy intellekt platformasi: o‘qiyotgan mavzu va imtihon sanasiga qarab kurs tuzadi, har kuni nima qilishni ko‘rsatadi, bir necha kundan keyin bilimni qayta tekshiradi va tayyorlik darajasini ko‘rsatadi. Universitet talabalari va til yoki sertifikat imtihoniga tayyorlanuvchilar uchun; maktab va o‘quv markazlari uchun versiyasi ham bor.
description.en: BiliMind is an AI exam-preparation platform: based on the subject and exam date it builds a course, shows what to do each day, re-checks knowledge after a few days and shows readiness level. It is for university students and those preparing for language or certification exams, with a version for schools and learning centers.

description.uz: BilimUz — ta’lim texnologiyalari (EdTech) sohasidagi startap; Toshkent shahrida faoliyat yuritadi.
description.en: BilimUz is a startup in the EdTech sector, operating in Tashkent City.

description.uz: BinoCRM — O‘zbekistondagi qurilish va ko‘chmas mulk ishlab chiqish kompaniyalari uchun maxsus yaratilgan SaaS asosidagi mijozlar bilan ishlash (CRM) platformasi.
description.en: BinoCRM is a niche SaaS customer relationship management (CRM) platform built specifically for construction and real estate development companies in Uzbekistan.

description.uz: Birga — Toshkent shahrida faoliyat yuritayotgan startap.
description.en: Birga is a startup operating in Tashkent City.

description.uz: Bitimchi AI — Toshkent shahrida faoliyat yuritayotgan startap.
description.en: Bitimchi AI is a startup based in Tashkent City.

tagline.en: ERP system that automates business processes

description.uz: BITO ERP savdo, ombor, ta’minot, moliya, HR va ishlab chiqarish kabi biznes jarayonlarini avtomatlashtiruvchi tizim ishlab chiqadi. Kompaniya boshqaruv tizimlarini ishlab chiqish, joriy etish va ularga xizmat ko‘rsatish bilan shug‘ullanadi.
description.en: BITO ERP develops a system that automates business processes such as sales, warehouse, supply, finance, HR and production. The company builds, implements and maintains management systems.

tagline.en: Privacy tool for hiding personal data in photos

description.en: Blurify is a privacy tool for blurring and pixelating faces, personal data (numbers, passport details) or the background in photos. It helps hide personal information before posting pictures on social media.

description.en: Braille Recognition is an AI-powered app that translates Braille into readable text. It is designed to help educators, parents and caregivers.

description.en: CancerFind is an AI-based mobile app that detects carcinogens in products and the environment. Users scan products to identify potentially cancer-causing substances; the platform also offers prevention, medical referral and consultation services for oncology patients.

description.en: DOPPI is a digital tourism ecosystem aimed at digitizing tourism in Uzbekistan. Through a Smart Map, AI assistant, marketplace, virtual tours and a travel feed it connects tourists with tourism businesses and supports domestic tourism and the promotion of history and culture.

description.en: EduSkill.uz is an educational platform offering modern digital and professional skills courses through video lectures, presentations and practical assignments. It aims to bridge the gap between traditional schooling and in-demand digital professions.

description.en: EduCoin is a coin platform bringing an innovative approach to education. It makes learning more engaging and motivating for students of learning centers and private schools.

O‘quvchi mavzuga mos 3D laboratoriyada ishlaydi, darslik sahifasini skaner qilsa tegishli tajriba aniqlanadi, sun’iy intellekt esa jarayonda yo‘l-yo‘riq beradi. Dastlab 6–11-sinflar fizika fanini qamrab oladi.
description.en: Empira is an EdTech platform for learning natural sciences interactively. Students work in a topic-specific 3D lab, scanning a textbook page identifies the relevant experiment, and AI guides them through it. It initially covers grades 6–11 physics.

tagline.uz: IELTS va Multilevel darajasini aniqlovchi AI platforma
tagline.en: AI platform for determining IELTS and Multilevel level

description.uz: Examify — ingliz tili bilim darajasini aniqlovchi onlayn platforma. U reading, listening, writing va speaking ko‘nikmalarini baholab, foydalanuvchining Multilevel yoki IELTS darajasini aniqlaydi.
description.en: Examify is an online platform that determines English proficiency. It assesses reading, listening, writing and speaking skills to determine a user's Multilevel or IELTS level.

description.en: Faceium is an AI-powered platform that automates attendance tracking using real-time FaceID authentication and location verification. It is built for educational institutions and companies.
